title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Marvel: Spinner Rack Specials

paragraphs.text: Marvel: Spinner Rack Specials is a drop in the experimental Secret Lair Chaos Vault product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on July, 17-19, 2026, simultaneously with its availability at MagicCon Amstedam 2026.

This is another Universes Beyond Secret Lair drop in a series of products created for Magic: The Gathering by Hasbro ( Wizards of the Coast ) in collaboration with Marvel Entertainment . The set features Marvel Comics heroes and villains. Each card in the drop is also available in the main Magic: The Gathering ® | Marvel Super Heroes set that released around the same time.

In contrast to similar drops like the 2024 Secret Lair Drop Series: Burning Revelations and the 2025 Secret Lair Drop Series: A Devastation of Dragons , this drop was also sold online. It was first made available as a give-away to attendees of Summer Game Fest 2026. It became available for sale in limited quantities on July 17, 2026 at MagicCon Amsterdam 2026.
The drop was also advertised as Chaos Vault: het moment is daar , proclaiming that "the moment has arrived" in Dutch.
As an extra, each drop comes with a random bonus card from several options.
